title: Rage's Beyond Vanilla
description: This Modpack is a complete Overhaul of the Vanilla Minecraft experience, this mod packs adds new biomes, Terrain and structures in the style of Vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# Welcome to the **Ultimate Vanilla+** experience!
This modpack enhances the classic Minecraft feeling while staying true to its roots. Featuring stunning world generation with mods like Tectonic and Terralith, every new world feels fresh, vast, and full of adventure.

Visual upgrades like Shaders and multiple resource packs (including _Fresh Animations_) bring your world to life in vibrant detail. Performance-friendly optimization mods are included to ensure a smooth experience, even with the visual enhancements.

You're free to customize your journey, tweak settings, add your own flair, or disable mods to suit your playstyle.

**Enjoy exploring, building, and surviving in a beautifully enhanced Minecraft world. Have fun and enjoy the adventure!**

### My Tip for better FPS:

- turn off VSync immediately (from 60 to 120 FPS)

- Render distance to 10 Chunks and
Simulation Distance to 8 Chunks
(from 96 to 120 FPS)
- go to video settings, then to performance, turn off _Use Entity Culling_
- change the shader or/and the settings of the shader however you like
- Please set the RAM to a higher value than the default, about half the RAM your PC has!


### For better Gameplay: 
- please change the FOV to 90 or higher
- go to the controls and search for Toggle Sail and change the Key from r to h
- feel free to customize the keybindings to your liking
‎ 

### Remember that this is a modpack that requires good PC components!
